description: Insert a cross-reference at a point in text that points to a paragraph or to a text anchor and shows it through a cross-reference format (Type > Hyperlinks & Cross-References > Insert Cross-Reference).

at.description: Where the cross-reference text goes: after the chosen text unless before is true

before.description: Use the point before the chosen text instead of the point after it

find.description: Text to find in the document (matched case-sensitively); the match is used

frameId.description: A text frame id; the text in that frame is used

length.description: With start: how many characters; 0 or absent means the point at start

occurrence.description: With find: which match to use, 1 for the first (default 1)

selection.description: Use the current text selection or text cursor

start.description: With storyId or frameId: the first character, counted from 0

storyId.description: A story id (get_document_stories lists them); its text is used

destination.description: What it points to: one of paragraph or anchor

anchor.description: The name of an existing text anchor

paragraph.description: A paragraph: the paragraph holding this text

find.description: Text to find in the document (matched case-sensitively); the match is used

frameId.description: A text frame id; the text in that frame is used

length.description: With start: how many characters; 0 or absent means the point at start

occurrence.description: With find: which match to use, 1 for the first (default 1)

selection.description: Use the current text selection or text cursor

start.description: With storyId or frameId: the first character, counted from 0

storyId.description: A story id (get_document_stories lists them); its text is used

format.description: Cross-reference format name (e.g. "Full Paragraph & Page Number", "Page Number")

name.description: Name for the cross-reference in the Hyperlinks panel

name: insert_cross_reference
title: Insert Cross Reference
